description: Τμήμα Αναπτύξεως Υδάτων: water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Open Data Portal Cyprus, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Τμήμα Αναπτύξεως Υδάτων. Coverage: Τμήμα Αναπτύξεως Υδάτων. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Διάθεση Νερού για Άρδευση ανά Έτος (Πηγές Άρδευσης); Διάθεση Νερού για Ύδρευση ανά Έτος (Πηγές Ύδρευσης); Θέσεις Σταθμών Επεξεργασίας Λυμάτων (INSIRE); Θέσεις Σταθμών Επεξεργασίας Λυμάτων (INSPIRE). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-national-open-data-portal-cyprus.
